models_evaluated: two other unnamed commercial ICH detection algorithms

links.outcome: Sensitivity and specificity of three commercial AI algorithms versus radiologists on the same CT exams
links.effect: Aidoc performed best, with 90.3% sensitivity and 99.0% specificity; AI performance varied substantially, and only one system showed clinically relevant accuracy.
links.quote: Aidoc performed best, with 90.3% sensitivity and 99.0% specificity.

links.outcome: Sensitivity and specificity of simulated combined human-AI reading versus AI alone
links.effect: Simulated combination of Aidoc with a human reader increased sensitivity to 96.0% while maintaining 99.4% specificity (P < 0.001), using an idealized logical OR model; overreliance was not assessed.
links.quote: A simulated mathematical combination of Aidoc with a human reader increased sensitivity to 96.0% while maintaining 99.4% specificity (P < 0.001), comparable to two radiologists.

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation and head-to-head comparison of three commercial imaging AI algorithms, testing a simulated human-AI teaming / concurrent reading strategy against human readers alone.
